entities.summary: Corey Hawkins is an American former professional basketball player currently working as an assistant coach for the Osceola Magic of the NBA G League. He played college basketball with the UC Davis Aggies, and was a three-time all-conference selection in the Big West Conference. As a senior in 2014–15, he was named the Big West Player of the Year.
